verses.19:21: He said to him, "Go down and solemnly warn the people, so that they do not wish to cross the boundaries to see the Lord, and a very great multitude of them perish.
verses.19:22: Let the priests also who approach the Lord be consecrated, so that He does not strike them."
verses.19:23: And Moses said to the Lord, "The common people will not be able to go up onto Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned and commanded, saying, 'Set boundaries around the mountain, and consecrate it.'"
verses.19:24: The Lord said to him, "Go, descend, and you will come up, and Aaron with you; but the priests and the people must not cross the boundaries nor go up to the Lord, so that He may not kill them."
verses.19:25: And Moses came down to the people and recounted everything to them.
verses.20:1: Then the Lord spoke all these words:
verses.20:2: "I am the Lord your God, who led you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
verses.20:3: You must not have foreign gods before Me.
verses.20:4: You must not make for yourself a carved image, nor any likeness of what is in heaven above, or of what is on the earth below, nor of those things that are in the waters beneath the earth.
verses.20:5: You must not worship them or revere them: I am the Lord your God, mighty and jealous, visiting the iniquity of fathers on children, into the third and fourth generation of those who hate Me,
verses.20:6: and showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My precepts.
verses.20:7: You must not take up the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not regard as guiltless the one who takes up the name of the Lord his God for nothing.
verses.20:8: Remember to sanctify the Sabbath day.
verses.20:9: For six days you will labor, and you will do all your work.
verses.20:10: But on the seventh day is a Sabbath of the Lord your God: you must not do any work on it, you, and your son and your daughter, your male slave and your female slave, your livestock, and the resident foreigner who is within your gates.
verses.20:11: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and the sea, and everything that is in them, and He rested on the seventh day; for this reason the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and sanctified it.
verses.20:12: Honor your father and your mother, so that you may be long-lived on the land that the Lord your God will give to you.
verses.20:16: You must not speak false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.20:17: You must not covet your neighbor's house, nor desire his wife, not his male slave, not his female slave, not his ox, not his donkey, nor anything that belongs to him."
verses.20:18: Now all the people saw the voices and the torches, and the sound of the trumpet, and the smoking mountain; and terrified and shaken with dread, they stood far off,
verses.20:19: saying to Moses, "You speak to us, and we will listen; let the Lord not speak to us, or else we might die."
verses.20:20: And Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid, for God has come to test you, and so that terror of Him might be in you, and you would not sin."
verses.20:21: And the people stood at a distance. But Moses approached the dense darkness in which God was.
verses.20:22: Furthermore, the Lord said to Moses, "This is what you will say to the sons of Israel: 'You yourselves have seen that I have spoken to you from heaven.
verses.20:23: You must not make silver gods, nor make gold gods for yourselves.
verses.20:24: You will make an altar of earth for Me, and you will offer on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and oxen, in every place where there is a remembrance of My name: I will come to you and bless you.
verses.20:25: And if you make a stone altar for Me, you must not build it from cut stones; for if you lift a knife over it, it will be defiled.
verses.20:26: You must not go up by steps to My altar, so that your nakedness is not uncovered.'"
verses.21:1: "These are the judgments that you will set before them.
verses.21:2: If you buy a Hebrew slave, he will serve you for six years; in the seventh he will go out free, without charge.
verses.21:3: With whatever clothing he enters, with the same let him go out; if he has a wife, the wife will also go out at the same time.
verses.21:4: But if the master gives him a wife, and she bears sons and daughters, the woman and her children will belong to his master, while he himself will go out with his clothing.
verses.21:5: And if the slave says, 'I love my master and my wife and children; I will not go out free,'
verses.21:6: the master will present him to the gods, and he will be brought up against the door and the doorposts, and the master will pierce his ear with an awl, and he will be a slave to him forever.
verses.21:7: If anyone sells his daughter as a female servant, she will not go out as female slaves are accustomed to go out.
verses.21:8: If she displeases the eyes of her master to whom she had been delivered, he will let her go; however, he will not have authority to sell her to a foreign people, if he has spurned her.
verses.21:9: But if he betroths her to his son, he will deal with her according to the custom of daughters.
verses.21:10: And if he takes another woman for him, he will provide marriage for the girl, and clothing, and he will not deny the price of chastity.
verses.21:11: If he does not do these three things, she will go out without charge, without money.
verses.21:12: Whoever strikes a person, intending to kill, must surely die.
verses.21:13: But the one who did not lie in wait—rather, God delivered that one into his hands—I will appoint a place for you to which he should flee.
verses.21:14: If anyone deliberately kills his neighbor, and by ambush, you will tear him away from My altar, so that he may die.
verses.21:15: Whoever strikes his father or mother must surely die.
verses.21:16: Whoever steals a person and sells him, having been convicted of the offense, must surely die.
verses.21:17: Whoever curses his father or mother must surely die.
verses.21:18: If men quarrel, and one strikes his neighbor with a stone or with a fist, and that one does not die but lies in bed,
verses.21:19: if he gets up and walks outside on his staff, the one who struck him will be innocent, provided, however, that he makes restitution for his labor and the expenses for physicians.
verses.21:20: Whoever strikes his male slave or female slave with a rod, and they die in his hands, will be guilty of a crime.
verses.21:21: But if the slave survives one day or two, the master will not be subject to punishment, because the slave is his money.
verses.21:22: If men quarrel, and someone strikes a pregnant woman, and she indeed suffers a miscarriage, yet she herself lives, he will be subject to damages, as much as the woman's husband demands and the arbitrators judge.
verses.21:23: But if her death follows, he will pay life for life,
verses.21:24: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.21:25: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
verses.21:26: If anyone strikes the eye of his male slave or female slave and makes them one-eyed, he will let them go free for the eye that he put out.
verses.21:27: Also, if he knocks out a tooth of his male slave or female slave, he will likewise let them go free.
verses.21:28: If an ox strikes a man or a woman with its horn and they die, it will be stoned to death, and its flesh will not be eaten; the owner of the ox will also be innocent.
verses.21:29: But if the ox has been prone to goring from yesterday and the day before, and they have warned its owner, and he has not confined it, and it kills a man or a woman, both the ox will be stoned to death and they will kill its owner.
verses.21:30: But if a price is imposed on him, he will give for his life whatever is demanded of him.
verses.21:31: Also, if it strikes a son or a daughter with its horn, he will be subject to a similar sentence.
verses.21:32: If it attacks a male slave or a female slave, he will give thirty shekels of silver to the master, while the ox will be crushed with stones.
verses.21:33: If anyone opens a cistern, and digs it, and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
verses.21:34: the owner of the cistern will pay the price of the livestock; but what is dead will belong to him.
verses.21:35: If one person's ox wounds another's ox, and it dies, they will sell the live ox and divide the price, while they will apportion the carcass of the dead one between themselves.
verses.21:36: But if its owner knew that the ox was prone to goring from yesterday and the day before, and he did not guard it, he will pay ox for ox, and he will receive the whole carcass."
verses.22:1: If anyone steals an ox or a sheep, and kills or sells it, he will restore five oxen for one ox and four sheep for one sheep.
verses.22:2: If a thief is found breaking into a house or digging under it, and dies after receiving a wound, the one who struck him shall not be guilty of blood.
verses.22:3: But if he does this after the sun has risen, he has committed homicide, and he himself shall die. If he does not have anything to pay back for the theft, he himself shall be sold.
verses.22:4: If what he stole is found alive in his possession, whether an ox, a donkey, or a sheep, he shall restore double.
verses.22:5: If anyone damages a field or a vineyard and lets his livestock loose so that it grazes on what belongs to another, he shall restore the best of whatever he has in his own field or in his vineyard, according to the valuation of the damage.
verses.22:6: If fire breaks out and reaches thorns, and takes hold of stacks of crops or standing grain in the fields, the one who kindled the fire shall repay the damage.
verses.22:7: If someone entrusts money or a vessel to a friend for safekeeping, and they are taken away by theft from the one who had received them, if the thief is found, he shall pay back double.
verses.22:8: If the thief remains hidden, the owner of the house shall be brought before the gods and shall swear that he did not stretch out his hand against his neighbor's property,
verses.22:9: to commit fraud, whether concerning an ox or a donkey, or a sheep or a garment, or anything that can cause loss; the case of both parties shall come before the gods, and if they pass judgment, he shall restore double to his neighbor.
verses.22:10: If someone entrusts a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any livestock to his neighbor for safekeeping, and it dies, or is crippled, or is captured by enemies, and no one has seen it,
verses.22:11: an oath shall be between them that he did not stretch out his hand to his neighbor's property; and the owner shall accept the oath, and the other shall not be compelled to repay.
verses.22:12: But if it was taken away by theft, he shall restore the loss to the owner.
verses.22:13: If it was eaten by a wild animal, let him bring to him what was killed, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.22:14: Whoever borrows any of these from his neighbor, and it is crippled or dies while the owner is not present, shall be compelled to repay.
verses.22:15: But if the owner was present, he shall not make restitution, especially if it had come hired for the wages of its work.
verses.22:16: If someone seduces a virgin not yet betrothed and sleeps with her, he shall provide a dowry for her and have her as his wife.
verses.22:17: If the virgin's father refuses to give her, he shall pay money according to the measure of the dowry that virgins are accustomed to receive.
verses.22:18: You shall not permit sorcerers to live.
verses.22:19: Whoever has sexual relations with an animal must surely die.
verses.22:20: Whoever sacrifices to gods, except to the Lord alone, shall be put to death.
verses.22:21: You shall not grieve a stranger, nor afflict him, for you yourselves were also strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.22:22: You shall not harm a widow or an orphan.
verses.22:23: If you injure them, they will cry out to Me, and I will hear their outcry.
verses.22:24: And My fury will be aroused, and I will strike you with the sword, and your wives will become widows and your children orphans.
verses.22:25: If you lend money to a poor person of My people who lives with you, you shall not press him like a creditor, nor oppress him with interest.
verses.22:26: If you take a garment from your neighbor as a pledge, you shall return it to him before sunset.
verses.22:27: For that is the only thing with which he is covered, the clothing of his flesh, and he has nothing else in which to sleep. If he cries out to Me, I will hear him, because I am merciful.
verses.22:28: You shall not revile the gods, and you shall not curse the ruler of your people.
verses.22:29: You shall not delay to render your tithes and your firstfruits; the firstborn of your sons you shall give to Me.
verses.22:30: With oxen and sheep also you shall do the same: for seven days let it stay with its mother; on the eighth day you shall render it to Me.
verses.22:31: You shall be holy men to Me: you shall not eat meat that has been tasted beforehand by wild animals, but you shall throw it to the dogs.
verses.23:1: You shall not accept a report of falsehood, nor join your hand to give false testimony on behalf of a wicked person.
verses.23:2: You shall not follow a crowd to do evil, nor in judgment yield to the opinion of the majority so as to turn aside from the truth.
verses.23:3: You shall not show pity to a poor person in judgment either.
verses.23:4: If you come upon your enemy's ox or donkey straying, lead it back to him.
verses.23:5: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying under its load, you shall not pass by, but you shall lift it up with him.
verses.23:6: You shall not turn aside in the judgment of a poor person.
verses.23:7: You shall flee from falsehood. You shall not put the innocent and the righteous to death, for I abhor the wicked.
verses.23:8: Nor shall you accept gifts, which blind even the prudent and overturn the words of the righteous.
verses.23:9: You shall not trouble a foreigner. For you know the souls of strangers, because you yourselves were also foreigners in the land of Egypt.
verses.23:10: For six years you shall sow your land and gather its crops.
verses.23:11: But in the seventh year you shall leave it alone and let it rest, so that the poor of your people may eat, and whatever remains, let the wild animals of the field eat. You shall do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.
verses.23:12: For six days you shall work; on the seventh day you shall cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest, and the son of your female servant and the stranger may be refreshed.
verses.23:13: Keep all the things that I have said to you. And you shall not swear by the name of foreign gods, nor shall it be heard from your mouth.
verses.23:14: Three times each year you shall celebrate feasts to Me.
verses.23:15: You shall keep the solemn feast of unleavened bread. For seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I commanded you, at the time of the month of new crops, when you came out of Egypt. You shall not appear in My sight empty-handed.
verses.23:16: And the solemn feast of the harvest of the first produce of your labor, whatever you have sown in the field; and also the solemn feast at the end of the year, when you have gathered all your crops from the field.
verses.23:17: Three times in the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord your God.
verses.23:18: You shall not sacrifice the blood of My offering over leaven, nor shall the fat of My solemn feast remain until morning.
verses.23:19: You shall bring the firstfruits of the crops of your land into the house of the Lord your God. You shall not cook a young goat in the milk of its mother.
verses.23:20: Look, I will send My angel to go ahead of you, to guard you on the way, and to bring you into the place that I have prepared.
verses.23:21: Pay careful attention to him and listen to his voice, and do not think he is to be disregarded, because he will not forgive when you sin, and My name is in him.
verses.23:22: But if you listen to his voice and do everything that I speak, I will be an enemy to your enemies and I will afflict those who afflict you.
verses.23:23: And My angel will go ahead of you and bring you to the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, whom I will crush.
verses.23:24: You shall not worship their gods, nor serve them; you shall not do their deeds, but you shall destroy them and shatter their statues.
verses.23:25: And you shall serve the Lord your God, so that I may bless your bread and waters, and remove sickness from your midst.
verses.23:26: There will be neither an unfruitful nor a barren woman in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.23:27: I will send My terror as your forerunner, and I will kill every people among whom you enter, and I will turn the backs of all your enemies before you,
verses.23:28: sending out hornets beforehand, which will put to flight the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites before you enter.
verses.23:29: I will not drive them out from before your face in one year, so that the land may not be reduced to a desolation and the wild animals increase against you.
verses.23:30: Little by little I will expel them from your sight, until you increase and possess the land.
verses.23:31: And I will set your boundaries from the Red Sea as far as the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert as far as the river; I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hands, and I will drive them out from your sight.
verses.23:32: You shall not enter into a covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.23:33: Let them not live in your land, so that they might not cause you to sin against Me if you serve their gods, which will certainly be a stumbling block to you.
verses.24:1: He also said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy elders from Israel, and you shall worship from a distance.
verses.24:2: And Moses alone shall come up to the Lord, and they shall not come near, nor shall the people come up with him."
verses.24:3: So Moses came and recounted to the people all the words of the Lord and the judgments; and all the people answered with one voice, "All the words of the Lord that He has spoken, we will do."
verses.24:4: And Moses wrote down all the words of the Lord; and rising early in the morning, he built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve monuments according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.24:5: And he sent young men from among the sons of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings to the Lord, calves.
verses.24:6: So Moses took half of the blood and put it into bowls, and the remaining part he poured on the altar.
verses.24:7: And taking the scroll of the covenant, he read it in the hearing of the people; and they said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient."
verses.24:8: Then he took the blood and sprinkled it on the people, and said, "This is the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you concerning all these words."
verses.24:9: And Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up,
verses.24:10: and they saw the God of Israel; and under His feet was something like a work of sapphire stone, and like the sky when it is clear.
verses.24:11: And He did not lay His hand upon those of the sons of Israel who had withdrawn to a distance; and they saw God, and ate and drank.
verses.24:12: And the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to Me on the mountain and remain there; and I will give you tablets of stone, and the law and the commandments that I have written, so that you may teach them."
verses.24:13: Moses and his attendant Joshua rose up; and as Moses went up onto the mountain of God,
verses.24:14: he said to the elders, "Wait here until we return to you. You have Aaron and Hur with you; if any question arises, you shall refer it to them."
verses.24:15: And when Moses had gone up, a cloud covered the mountain,
verses.24:16: and the glory of the Lord dwelt on Sinai, covering it with the cloud for six days; and on the seventh day He called him from the midst of the thick darkness.
verses.24:17: Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a burning fire on the summit of the mountain in the sight of the sons of Israel.
verses.24:18: And Moses entered the midst of the mist and went up onto the mountain, and he was there for forty days and forty nights.
verses.25:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.25:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, that they take up firstfruits for Me; from every person who offers willingly, you shall receive them.
verses.25:3: And these are the things that you are to receive: gold, and silver, and bronze,
verses.25:4: violet-blue and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, and fine linen, goat hair,
verses.25:5: and ram skins dyed red, and violet skins, and acacia wood;
verses.25:6: oil for preparing the lamps; spices for the ointment, and incense of pleasant fragrance;
verses.25:7: onyx stones, and gems for adorning the ephod and the breastpiece.
verses.25:8: And they shall make a sanctuary for Me, and I will dwell in their midst,
verses.25:9: according to the entire likeness of the tabernacle that I will show you, and of all the vessels for its service. And in this way you shall make it:
verses.25:10: construct an ark of acacia wood, whose length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and its height likewise a cubit and a half.
verses.25:11: And you shall overlay it with purest gold, inside and outside; and you shall make on top a golden crown all around,
verses.25:12: and four golden rings, which you shall place at the four corners of the ark: two rings shall be on one side, and two on the other.
verses.25:13: You shall also make poles of acacia wood and cover them with gold.
verses.25:14: And you shall insert them through the rings that are on the sides of the ark, so that it may be carried by them;
verses.25:15: they shall always remain in the rings and shall never be drawn out from them.
verses.25:16: And you shall place in the ark the testimony that I will give you.
verses.25:17: You shall also make a mercy seat of purest gold: its length shall measure two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half.
verses.25:18: You shall also make two golden cherubim of hammered work on each side of the oracle.
verses.25:19: One cherub shall be on one side, and the other on the other.
verses.25:20: They shall shield both sides of the mercy seat, spreading out their wings and covering the oracle, and they shall look at one another with their faces turned toward the mercy seat with which the ark is to be covered,
verses.25:21: in which you shall place the testimony that I will give you.
verses.25:22: From there I will give commands, and I will speak to you above the mercy seat and from the midst of the two cherubim that will be upon the ark of the testimony, all that I will command the sons of Israel through you.
verses.25:23: You shall also make a table of acacia wood, having a length of two cubits, and in width a cubit, and in height a cubit and a half.
verses.25:24: And you shall overlay it with purest gold, and you shall make for it a golden rim all around,
verses.25:25: and for the rim itself a carved crown four fingers high, and above it another small golden crown.
verses.25:26: You shall also prepare four golden rings and place them at the four corners of the same table, at each foot.
verses.25:27: Beneath the crown shall be the golden rings, so that the poles may be put through them and the table may be carried.
verses.25:28: You shall also make the poles themselves of acacia wood and encase them with gold for carrying the table.
verses.25:29: You shall also prepare, of purest gold, dishes and bowls, censers and cups, in which libations are to be offered.
verses.25:30: And you shall place upon the table the loaves of presentation in My sight always.
verses.25:31: You shall also make a hammered lampstand of purest gold, its shaft and branches, cups, small globes, and lilies proceeding from it.
verses.25:32: Six branches shall go out from its sides, three from one side and three from the other.
verses.25:33: Three cups as if in the shape of a nut on each branch, together with a small globe and a lily; and likewise three cups in the likeness of a nut on the other branch, together with a small globe and a lily. This shall be the workmanship of the six branches that are to be brought out from the shaft;
verses.25:34: and on the lampstand itself there shall be four cups in the shape of a nut, and small globes on each one, and lilies.
verses.25:35: There shall be small globes under two branches in three places, which together make six proceeding from one shaft.
verses.25:36: Therefore both the small globes and the branches shall be from it, all of hammered work of purest gold.
verses.25:37: You shall also make seven lamps, and you shall set them upon the lampstand so that they may give light opposite it.
verses.25:38: The snuffers also, and the receptacles where what has been snuffed is extinguished, shall be made of purest gold.
verses.25:39: The entire weight of the lampstand with all its vessels shall be a talent of purest gold.
verses.25:40: Look carefully, and make it according to the model that was shown to you on the mountain."
verses.26:1: Now you shall make the tabernacle in this way: you shall make ten curtains of twisted fine linen, and violet-blue, and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, variegated with embroidered work.
verses.26:2: The length of one curtain shall measure twenty-eight cubits, and the width shall be four cubits. All the hangings shall be made of one measurement.
verses.26:3: Five curtains shall be joined to one another, and the other five shall be linked together by a similar fastening.
verses.26:4: You shall make violet-blue loops on the sides and edges of the curtains, so that they may be coupled to one another.
verses.26:5: The curtain shall have fifty loops on each side, inserted in such a way that loop comes opposite loop, and the one may be fitted to the other.
verses.26:6: You shall also make fifty golden rings by which the drapes of the curtains are to be joined, so that one tabernacle may be made.
verses.26:7: You shall also make eleven cloths of goats' hair to cover the roof of the tabernacle.
verses.26:8: The length of one cloth shall measure thirty cubits, and the width four; the measurement of all the cloths shall be equal.
verses.26:9: Of these, you shall join five separately, and six you shall couple to one another, so that you double the sixth cloth at the front of the roof.
verses.26:10: You shall also make fifty loops on the border of one cloth, so that it can be joined with the other, and fifty loops on the border of the other cloth, so that it may be coupled with the other.
verses.26:11: You shall also make fifty bronze clasps by which the loops may be joined, so that one covering may be made out of all of them.
verses.26:12: Now as for what remains over from the cloths that are prepared for the roof, that is, the one cloth that is extra, with half of it you shall cover the back of the tabernacle.
verses.26:13: And a cubit shall hang down on one side, and another on the other side, which is extra in the length of the cloths, protecting each side of the tabernacle.
verses.26:14: You shall also make another covering for the roof out of rams' skins dyed red, and over this again another covering of violet-colored skins.
verses.26:15: You shall also make upright boards of the tabernacle from acacia wood,
verses.26:16: which shall each have ten cubits in length, and one and a half cubits in width.
verses.26:17: In the sides of a board, two mortise joints shall be made, by which one board may be connected to another board; and in this manner all the boards shall be prepared.
verses.26:18: Of these, twenty shall be on the southern side that faces toward the south.
verses.26:19: For these you shall cast forty silver bases, so that two bases may be placed underneath each board at the two corners.
verses.26:20: Also on the second side of the tabernacle, which faces toward the north, there shall be twenty boards,
verses.26:21: having forty silver bases; two bases shall be set beneath each board.
verses.26:22: Now toward the western quarter of the tabernacle you shall make six boards,
verses.26:23: and again two others that shall be erected in the corners behind the back of the tabernacle.
verses.26:24: And they shall be joined together from the bottom to the top, and one fastening shall hold them all together. For the two boards also that are to be placed in the corners, a similar joint shall be maintained.
verses.26:25: And altogether there shall be eight boards, and their silver bases sixteen, with two bases counted for each board.
verses.26:26: You shall also make five bars of acacia wood to hold the boards together on one side of the tabernacle,
verses.26:27: and five others on the other side, and of the same number toward the western quarter,
verses.26:28: which shall be passed through the middle of the boards from one end to the other.
verses.26:29: You shall also gild the boards themselves, and you shall cast golden rings on them through which the bars may hold the boarding together; and these you shall cover with golden plates.
verses.26:30: And you shall erect the tabernacle according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.26:31: You shall also make a veil of violet-blue, and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, and twisted fine linen, woven together with embroidered work and beautiful variety,
verses.26:32: which you shall hang before four pillars of acacia wood, which themselves indeed shall be gilded, and shall have golden capitals, but silver bases.
verses.26:33: Now the veil shall be inserted through the rings, within which you shall place the ark of the testimony, by which both the sanctuary and the sanctuaries of the sanctuary shall be divided.
verses.26:34: You shall also place the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the Holy of Holies,
verses.26:35: and the table outside the veil, and opposite the table the lampstand on the southern side of the tabernacle; for the table shall stand on the northern side.
verses.26:36: You shall also make a hanging at the entrance of the tabernacle of violet-blue, and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, and twisted fine linen, with the work of an embroiderer.
verses.26:37: And you shall gild five pillars of acacia wood, before which the hanging shall be drawn, whose capitals shall be golden, and whose bases shall be bronze.
verses.27:1: You shall also make an altar of acacia wood, which shall have five cubits in length and just as many in width, that is, square, and three cubits in height.
verses.27:2: Now horns at the four corners shall be made from it itself, and you shall cover it with bronze.
verses.27:3: And for its uses you shall make pots for receiving the ashes, and tongs and forks, and receptacles for fire; all the vessels you shall fashion out of bronze.
verses.27:4: And you shall make a bronze grating in the manner of a net, at whose four corners there shall be four bronze rings.
verses.27:5: These you shall place beneath the hearth of the altar, and the grating shall reach as far as the middle of the altar.
verses.27:6: You shall also make two bars of acacia wood for the altar, which you shall cover with bronze plates,
verses.27:7: and you shall pass them through the rings, and they shall be on each side of the altar for carrying.
verses.27:8: You shall make it not solid, but empty and hollow on the inside, just as was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.27:9: You shall also make the courtyard of the tabernacle, on whose southern quarter facing the south there shall be hangings of twisted fine linen; one side shall extend one hundred cubits in length.
verses.27:10: And you shall make twenty pillars with just as many bronze bases, which shall have silver capitals together with their engravings.
verses.27:11: Likewise also along the length on the northern side there shall be hangings of one hundred cubits, twenty pillars, and bronze bases of the same number, and their capitals with their engravings of silver.
verses.27:12: Now along the width of the courtyard, which faces toward the west, there shall be hangings for fifty cubits, and ten pillars, and just as many bases.
verses.27:13: On that width of the courtyard also that faces toward the east, there shall be fifty cubits.
verses.27:14: Of these, hangings of fifteen cubits shall be assigned to one side, and three pillars and just as many bases;
verses.27:15: and on the other side there shall be hangings spanning fifteen cubits, three pillars, and just as many bases.
verses.27:16: Now at the entrance of the courtyard a hanging of twenty cubits shall be made of violet-blue and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, and twisted fine linen, with the work of an embroiderer; it shall have four pillars, with just as many bases.
verses.27:17: All the pillars of the courtyard all around shall be clad with silver plates, with silver capitals and bronze bases.
verses.27:18: In length the courtyard shall occupy one hundred cubits, in width fifty; the height shall be five cubits, and it shall be made of twisted fine linen, and shall have bronze bases.
verses.27:19: All the vessels of the tabernacle for all uses and ceremonies, both its pegs and those of the courtyard, you shall make out of bronze.
verses.27:20: Command the sons of Israel to bring to you oil from olive trees, most pure and crushed with a pestle, so that the lamp may burn continually
verses.27:21: in the tabernacle of the testimony, outside the veil that is stretched before the testimony. And Aaron and his sons shall set it in place, so that it may shine until morning before the Lord. It shall be a perpetual observance throughout their generations by the sons of Israel.
verses.28:1: Bring near to yourself also Aaron your brother with his sons from the midst of the sons of Israel, so that they may exercise the priesthood for Me: Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.28:2: And you will make a holy garment for Aaron your brother, for glory and beauty.
verses.28:3: And you will speak to all the wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of prudence, so that they may make the garments of Aaron, in which, having been sanctified, he may minister to Me.
verses.28:4: Now these will be the vestments that he will make: a breastpiece and a shoulder vestment, a tunic and a close-fitting linen garment, a turban and a sash. They will make holy vestments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may exercise the priesthood for Me.
verses.28:5: And they will receive gold, violet-blue, purple, twice-dyed scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.28:6: Now they will make the shoulder vestment of gold, violet-blue, purple, twice-dyed scarlet, and twisted fine linen, in variegated woven work.
verses.28:7: It will have two joined borders on each side of the upper ends, so that they may come together into one.
verses.28:8: The weaving itself also, and all the variety of the work, will be of gold, violet-blue, purple, twice-dyed scarlet, and twisted fine linen.
verses.28:9: And you will take two onyx stones, and you will engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:
verses.28:10: six names on one stone, and the remaining six on the other, according to the order of their birth.
verses.28:11: With the work of a carver and the engraving of a gem-cutter, you will engrave them with the names of the sons of Israel, enclosed and encircled in gold:
verses.28:12: and you will place them on each side of the shoulder vestment, as a memorial for the sons of Israel. And Aaron will bear their names before the Lord on both shoulders, for remembrance.
verses.28:13: You will also make hooks of gold,
verses.28:14: and two small chains of the purest gold, linked to one another, which you will insert into the hooks.
verses.28:15: You will also make the breastpiece of judgment in variegated woven work, according to the weaving of the shoulder vestment, of gold, violet-blue, purple, twice-dyed scarlet, and twisted fine linen.
verses.28:16: It will be four-cornered and doubled: it will have the measure of a palm both in length and in width.
verses.28:17: And you will place in it four rows of stones: in the first row there will be a sardius stone, a topaz, and an emerald;
verses.28:18: in the second, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a jasper;
verses.28:19: in the third, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.28:20: in the fourth, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a beryl. They will be enclosed in gold in their rows.
verses.28:21: And they will have the names of the sons of Israel: they will be engraved with twelve names, each stone with the name of each one, for the twelve tribes.
verses.28:22: You will make on the breastpiece chains linked to one another of the purest gold,
verses.28:23: and two gold rings, which you will place at both ends of the breastpiece:
verses.28:24: and you will join the gold chains to the rings that are on its edges,
verses.28:25: and you will fasten the ends of the chains themselves to two hooks on each side of the shoulder vestment that faces the breastpiece.
verses.28:26: You will also make two gold rings, which you will place at the ends of the breastpiece, on the edges that are opposite the shoulder vestment and face its back side.
verses.28:27: And also two other gold rings, which are to be placed below on each side of the shoulder vestment that faces the front of the lower joining, so that it may be fitted together with the shoulder vestment,
verses.28:28: and the breastpiece may be bound tightly by its rings to the rings of the shoulder vestment with a blue cord, so that the finely crafted joining remains intact, and the breastpiece and the shoulder vestment cannot be separated from one another.
verses.28:29: And Aaron will bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment over his chest, when he enters the sanctuary, as a memorial before the Lord forever.
verses.28:30: Moreover, you will place in the breastpiece of judgment Doctrine and Truth, which will be on Aaron's chest when he enters before the Lord; and he will carry the judgment of the sons of Israel on his chest, in the sight of the Lord always.
verses.28:31: You will also make the tunic of the shoulder vestment entirely violet-blue,
verses.28:32: in the middle of which at the top there will be an opening for the head, and a woven border all around it, just as is customarily made at the outermost parts of garments, so that it may not easily be torn.
verses.28:33: Below, however, at the foot of that same tunic, all around, you will make, as it were, pomegranates, of violet-blue, purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, with bells mingled in between,
verses.28:34: so that there is a gold bell and a pomegranate, and again another gold bell and a pomegranate.
verses.28:35: And Aaron will be clothed with it in the office of ministry, so that the sound may be heard when he enters and leaves the sanctuary in the sight of the Lord, and he may not die.
verses.28:36: You will also make a plate of the purest gold, on which you will engrave with the work of an engraver: "Holy to the Lord."
verses.28:37: And you will bind it with a violet-blue ribbon, and it will be upon the headdress,
verses.28:38: overhanging the forehead of the high priest. And Aaron will bear the iniquities of those things which the sons of Israel have offered and sanctified in all their gifts and offerings. Now the plate will always be on his forehead, so that the Lord may be appeased toward them.
verses.28:39: And you will fit the tunic closely with fine linen, and you will make a headdress of fine linen, and a sash with the work of an embroiderer.
verses.28:40: Furthermore, for the sons of Aaron you will prepare linen tunics, and sashes and headdresses, for glory and beauty:
verses.28:41: and with all these you will clothe Aaron your brother and his sons with him. And you will consecrate the hands of all of them, and you will sanctify them, so that they may exercise the priesthood for Me.
verses.28:42: You will also make linen undergarments, so that they may cover the flesh of their shame, from the loins to the thighs:
verses.28:43: and Aaron and his sons will use them when they enter the tabernacle of the testimony, or when they approach the altar to minister in the sanctuary, so that they may not die guilty of iniquity. It will be an everlasting statute for Aaron, and for his seed after him.
verses.29:1: But you will also do this, so that they may be consecrated to Me in the priesthood. Take a calf from the herd, and two unblemished rams,
verses.29:2: and unleavened loaves, and a cake without leaven that is mixed with oil, and also unleavened wafers coated with oil; you will make all of them from fine wheat flour.
verses.29:3: And you will offer them placed in a basket, and also the calf and the two rams.
verses.29:4: And you will bring Aaron and his sons forward to the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony. And when you have washed the father along with his sons with water,
verses.29:5: you will clothe Aaron with his garments, that is, with the linen garment and the tunic, and with the shoulder vestment and the breastpiece, which you will fasten tightly with a sash.
verses.29:6: And you will place the headdress on his head, and the holy plate upon the headdress,
verses.29:7: and you will pour the anointing oil upon his head; and by this rite he will be consecrated.
verses.29:8: You will also bring his sons forward, and clothe them with linen tunics, and bind them with a sash,
verses.29:9: namely Aaron and his children, and you will place headwraps on them; and they will be priests to Me by a perpetual religious observance. After you have initiated their hands,
verses.29:10: you will also bring the calf forward before the tabernacle of the testimony. And Aaron and his sons will place their hands upon its head,
verses.29:11: and you will slaughter it in the sight of the Lord, beside the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.29:12: And taking some of the blood of the calf, you will put it upon the horns of the altar with your finger, but you will pour out the remaining blood beside its base.
verses.29:13: You will also take all the fat that covers the intestines, and the membrane of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and you will offer them to be burned upon the altar;
verses.29:14: but the flesh of the calf, and the hide, and the dung, you will burn up outside, beyond the camp, because it is for sin.
verses.29:15: You will also take one ram, upon whose head Aaron and his sons will place their hands.
verses.29:16: And when you have slaughtered it, you will take some of its blood, and pour it around the altar.
verses.29:17: And the ram itself you will cut into pieces; and having washed its intestines and feet, you will place them upon the cut flesh, and upon its head.
verses.29:18: And you will offer the whole ram to be burned upon the altar; it is an offering to the Lord, a most pleasing aroma of the sacrifice of the Lord.
verses.29:19: You will also take the other ram, upon whose head Aaron and his sons will place their hands.
verses.29:20: And when you have sacrificed it, you will take some of its blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron and of his sons, and upon the thumbs of their right hands and the big toes of their right feet, and you will pour the blood upon the altar all around.
verses.29:21: And when you have taken some of the blood that is upon the altar, and some of the anointing oil, you will sprinkle Aaron and his vestments, and his sons and their garments. And once they themselves and their vestments have been consecrated,
verses.29:22: you will take the fat from the ram, and the tail, and the suet that covers the vital organs, and the membrane of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder, because it is the ram of consecration;
verses.29:23: and one round loaf of bread, a cake mixed with oil, and a wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that has been placed in the sight of the Lord;
verses.29:24: and you will place them all upon the hands of Aaron and of his sons, and you will sanctify them, lifting them up before the Lord.
verses.29:25: And you will receive all of them from their hands, and burn them upon the altar as a burnt offering, a most pleasing aroma in the sight of the Lord, because it is His offering.
verses.29:26: You will also take the breast from the ram with which Aaron was initiated, and you will sanctify it, lifted up before the Lord, and it will fall to your share.
verses.29:27: And you will also sanctify the consecrated breast, and the shoulder that you separated from the ram,
verses.29:28: with which Aaron and his sons were initiated, and they will fall to the share of Aaron and his sons by a perpetual right from the sons of Israel; because they are firstfruits and first portions from their peace offerings that they offer to the Lord.
verses.29:29: And the holy vestment that Aaron will wear, his sons will have after him, so that they may be anointed in it, and their hands may be consecrated.
verses.29:30: The one from among his sons who has been appointed high priest in his place, and who will enter the tabernacle of the testimony to minister in the sanctuary, will wear it for seven days.
verses.29:31: And you will take the ram of consecration, and cook its flesh in a holy place;
verses.29:32: and Aaron and his sons will eat it. They will also eat the loaves that are in the basket in the vestibule of the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.29:33: so that it may be an appeasing sacrifice, and the hands of those offering may be sanctified. A foreigner will not eat from them, because they are holy.
verses.29:34: But if anything remains of the consecrated flesh or of the loaves until morning, you will burn up the remainder with fire; they will not be eaten, because they have been sanctified.
verses.29:35: You will do all the things that I have commanded you concerning Aaron and his sons. For seven days you will consecrate their hands,
verses.29:36: and you will offer a calf for sin each day to make atonement. And you will cleanse the altar when you have sacrificed the offering of atonement, and you will anoint it for sanctification.
verses.29:37: For seven days you will make atonement for the altar and sanctify it, and it will be most holy; everyone who touches it will be sanctified.
verses.29:38: This is what you will do upon the altar: two one-year-old lambs each day continually,
verses.29:39: one lamb in the morning, and the other in the evening,
verses.29:40: a tenth part of fine flour mixed with beaten oil, which has the measure of a fourth part of a hin, and wine for a drink offering of the same measure for one lamb.
verses.29:41: And you will offer the other lamb toward evening according to the rite of the morning offering, and according to the things that We have spoken, for a pleasing aroma;
verses.29:42: it is a sacrifice to the Lord, by a perpetual offering throughout your generations, at the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord, where I will arrange to speak to you.
verses.29:43: And there I will command the sons of Israel, and the altar will be sanctified in My glory.
verses.29:44: I will also sanctify the tabernacle of the testimony with the altar, and Aaron with his sons, so that they may exercise the priesthood for Me.
verses.29:45: And I will dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel, and I will be God to them,
verses.29:46: and they will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, so that I might remain among them; I am the Lord their God.
verses.30:1: "You shall also make an altar for burning incense, of acacia wood,
verses.30:2: having a cubit in length and another in width, that is, square, and two cubits in height. The horns shall proceed from it.
verses.30:3: And you shall overlay it with purest gold, both its grate and the walls all around, and the horns. And you shall make for it a small golden crown around it,
verses.30:4: and two golden rings under the crown on each side, so that poles may be inserted into them and the altar may be carried.
verses.30:5: You shall also make the poles themselves of acacia wood, and you shall overlay them with gold.
verses.30:6: And you shall place the altar opposite the veil that hangs before the ark of the testimony, in front of the mercy seat by which the testimony is covered, where I will speak to you.
verses.30:7: And Aaron shall burn sweetly fragrant incense on it in the morning. When he sets the lamps in order, he shall kindle it;
verses.30:8: and when he sets them in place at evening, he shall burn perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.
verses.30:9: You shall not offer on it incense of another composition, nor an offering and a sacrifice, nor shall you pour out libations.
verses.30:10: And Aaron shall make intercession over its horns once a year with the blood that was offered for sin, and he shall make atonement upon it in your generations. It shall be most holy to the Lord."
verses.30:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:12: "When you take the sum of the sons of Israel by number, they shall each give a price for their souls to the Lord, and there shall be no plague among them when they have been counted.
verses.30:13: Now everyone who passes by to be named shall give this: half a shekel according to the measure of the temple (a shekel has twenty obols); half of a shekel shall be offered to the Lord.
verses.30:14: Anyone who is included in the number, from twenty years old and above, shall give the price.
verses.30:15: The rich man shall not add to the half shekel, and the poor man shall subtract nothing.
verses.30:16: And the money received, which has been contributed by the sons of Israel, you shall hand over for the uses of the tabernacle of the testimony, so that it may be a memorial of them before the Lord, and He may be merciful to their souls."
verses.30:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.30:18: "You shall also make a bronze basin with its base for washing; and you shall place it between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar. And when water has been put in,
verses.30:19: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and feet in it,
verses.30:20: when they are about to enter the tabernacle of the testimony, and when they are about to approach the altar to offer incense on it to the Lord,
verses.30:21: so that they may not die; it shall be an everlasting statute for him and for his seed through successive generations."
verses.30:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
verses.30:23: saying, "Take for yourself spices: five hundred shekels of prime and choice myrrh, and half as much of cinnamon, that is, two hundred fifty shekels, likewise two hundred fifty of calamus,
verses.30:24: and five hundred shekels of cassia, by the weight of the sanctuary, a hin measure of oil from olive groves;
verses.30:25: and you shall make holy anointing oil, an ointment compounded by the work of a perfumer,
verses.30:26: and with it you shall anoint the tabernacle of the testimony, and the ark of the covenant,
verses.30:27: and the table with its vessels, and the lampstand and its utensils, the altars of incense
verses.30:28: and of burnt offering, and all the furnishings that pertain to their service.
verses.30:29: And you shall sanctify all of them, and they shall be most holy; whoever touches them shall be sanctified.
verses.30:30: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and you shall sanctify them, so that they may exercise the priesthood for Me.
verses.30:31: You shall also say to the sons of Israel, 'This anointing oil shall be holy to Me throughout your generations.
verses.30:32: The flesh of man shall not be anointed with it, and you shall not make another according to its composition, for it has been sanctified, and it shall be holy to you.
verses.30:33: Any person who compounds anything like it and gives any of it to an outsider shall be cut off from his people.'"
verses.30:34: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take for yourself spices: stacte and onycha, galbanum of pleasant fragrance, and clearest frankincense; all of them shall be of equal weight;
verses.30:35: and you shall make incense compounded by the work of a perfumer, carefully mixed, and pure, and most worthy of sanctification.
verses.30:36: And when you have pounded all of it into the finest powder, you shall place some of it before the tabernacle of the testimony, in the place where I will appear to you. The incense shall be most holy to you.
verses.30:37: You shall not make such a composition for your own uses, for it is holy to the Lord.
verses.30:38: Any person who makes anything like it in order to enjoy its fragrance shall perish from his peoples."
verses.31:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:2: "See, I have called by name Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
verses.31:3: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, and understanding, and knowledge in all work,
verses.31:4: to devise whatever can be crafted from gold, and silver, and bronze,
verses.31:5: marble, and gems, and a variety of woods.
verses.31:6: And I have given him as a companion Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And in the heart of every skilled person I have placed wisdom, so that they may make all things that I have commanded you:
verses.31:7: the tabernacle of the covenant, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is over it, and all the vessels of the tabernacle,
verses.31:8: and the table and its vessels, the purest lampstand with its vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.31:9: and that of burnt offering, and all their vessels, the basin with its base,
verses.31:10: the holy garments for the ministry, for Aaron the priest and his sons, so that they may perform their office in sacred things:
verses.31:11: the anointing oil, and the incense of spices in the sanctuary; they shall make all things that I have commanded you."
verses.31:12: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:13: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'See that you keep My Sabbath, for it is a sign between Me and you in your generations, so that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.31:14: Keep My Sabbath, for it is holy to you; whoever defiles it shall surely die; whoever does work on it, his soul shall perish from the midst of his people.
verses.31:15: Six days you shall do work; on the seventh day is a Sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord; everyone who does work on this day shall die.
verses.31:16: Let the sons of Israel keep the Sabbath, and celebrate it in their generations. It is an everlasting covenant
verses.31:17: between Me and the sons of Israel, and a perpetual sign; for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh He ceased from work.'"
verses.31:18: And the Lord gave to Moses, when words of this sort had been completed on Mount Sinai, two stone tablets of the testimony, written by the finger of God.
verses.32:1: Now the people, seeing that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, gathered against Aaron and said, "Get up, make gods for us who will go ahead of us; for as for this man Moses, who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him."
verses.32:2: And Aaron said to them, "Take the gold earrings from the ears of your wives, and of your sons and daughters, and bring them to me."
verses.32:3: And the people did what he had ordered, bringing the earrings to Aaron.
verses.32:4: When he had received them, he shaped them by the work of casting and made a cast calf out of them; and they said, "These are your gods, Israel, who led you out of the land of Egypt."
verses.32:5: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it, and called out with the voice of a herald, saying, "Tomorrow is a solemn festival of the Lord."
verses.32:6: And rising in the morning, they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and drink, and got up to play.
verses.32:7: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Go, go down; your people, whom you led out of the land of Egypt, have sinned.
verses.32:8: They have quickly departed from the way that you showed them; and they have made for themselves a cast calf, and worshiped it, and sacrificing offerings to it, they said, 'These are your gods, Israel, who led you out of the land of Egypt.'"
verses.32:9: And once again the Lord said to Moses, "I perceive that this people is stiff-necked.
verses.32:10: Leave Me alone, so that My fury may rage against them and I may blot them out, and I will make you into a great nation."
verses.32:11: But Moses prayed to the Lord his God, saying, "Why, Lord, does Your fury rage against Your people, whom You led out of the land of Egypt with great strength and with a mighty hand?
verses.32:12: Please do not let the Egyptians say, 'Craftily He led them out to kill them in the mountains and blot them out from the earth.' Let Your anger subside, and be appeased over the wickedness of Your people.
verses.32:13: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants, to whom You swore by Yourself, saying, 'I will multiply your seed like the stars of heaven; and all this land about which I have spoken I will give to your seed, and you will possess it forever.'"
verses.32:14: And the Lord was appeased, so that He did not do the harm that He had spoken against His people.
verses.32:15: And Moses returned from the mountain, carrying two tablets of the testimony in his hand, written on both sides,
verses.32:16: and made by the work of God; the writing of God also was engraved on the tablets.
verses.32:17: Now Joshua, hearing the uproar of the people shouting, said to Moses, "A howling of battle is heard in the camp."
verses.32:18: He answered, "It is not the clamor of those urging on to battle, nor the shouting of those driving to flight, but I hear the voice of those singing."
verses.32:19: And when he had approached the camp, he saw the calf and the dances; and greatly angered, he threw the tablets from his hand and shattered them at the base of the mountain.
verses.32:20: And seizing the calf that they had made, he burned it and ground it down to powder, which he scattered into the water, and gave a drink of it to the sons of Israel.
verses.32:21: And he said to Aaron, "What did this people do to you, that you should bring a very great sin upon them?"
verses.32:22: He answered him, "Do not let my lord be indignant; for you know this people, that they are prone to evil.
verses.32:23: They said to me, 'Make gods for us who will go ahead of us; for as for this Moses, who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.'
verses.32:24: To them I said, 'Who among you has gold?' They took it and gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and this calf came out."
verses.32:25: Moses therefore, seeing the people, that they were stripped naked (for Aaron had despoiled them on account of the disgrace of filth, and had set them naked among their enemies),
verses.32:26: and standing at the gate of the camp, said, "If anyone is the Lord's, let him join me." And all the sons of Levi gathered to him.
verses.32:27: To them he said, "This is what the Lord God of Israel says: 'Let each man place his sword upon his thigh; go and return from gate to gate through the middle of the camp, and let each one kill his brother, and his friend, and his neighbor.'"
verses.32:28: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses, and about twenty-three thousand men fell on that day.
verses.32:29: And Moses said, "You have consecrated your hands today to the Lord, each one against his son and against his brother, so that a blessing may be given to you."
verses.32:30: Now when the next day had come, Moses spoke to the people, "You have sinned a very great sin; I will go up to the Lord, if in any way I can plead with Him for your crime."
verses.32:31: And returning to the Lord, he said, "I implore You, this people has sinned a very great sin, and they have made gods of gold for themselves; either forgive them this offense,
verses.32:32: or if You do not do so, blot me out of Your book that You have written."
verses.32:33: The Lord answered him, "The one who has sinned against Me, I will blot him out of My book;
verses.32:34: but as for you, go and lead this people where I have spoken to you; My angel will go ahead of you. Yet on the day of vengeance I Myself will also punish this sin of theirs."
verses.32:35: Therefore the Lord struck the people for the guilt of the calf that Aaron had made.
verses.33:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Go, go up from this place, you and your people whom you led out of the land of Egypt, into the land that I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, 'To your seed I will give it';
verses.33:2: and I will send an angel as your forerunner, so that I may drive out the Canaanite, and the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite,
verses.33:3: and you may enter a land flowing with milk and honey. For I will not go up with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise I might destroy you on the way."
verses.33:4: And when the people heard this terrible word, they mourned, and no one dressed in his finery according to custom.
verses.33:5: And the Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the sons of Israel: 'You are a stiff-necked people; once I will go up in your midst and blot you out. Right now lay aside your adornment, so that I may know what I should do to you.'"
verses.33:6: Therefore the sons of Israel laid aside their adornment from Mount Horeb.
verses.33:7: Moses also, taking the tabernacle, pitched it far outside the camp, and called its name the Tabernacle of the Covenant. And everyone of the people who had any question would go out to the Tabernacle of the Covenant, outside the camp.
verses.33:8: And whenever Moses went out to the tabernacle, the entire populace would rise, and each one would stand at the entrance of his pavilion, and they would watch the back of Moses until he entered the tent.
verses.33:9: Now when he had entered the Tabernacle of the Covenant, the pillar of cloud would come down and stand at the entrance, and speak with Moses,
verses.33:10: while all saw that the pillar of cloud was standing at the entrance of the tabernacle. And they themselves would stand and worship at the doorways of their tents.
verses.33:11: Now the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just as a man usually speaks to his friend. And whenever he returned to the camp, his attendant Joshua son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tabernacle.
verses.33:12: Now Moses said to the Lord, "You command that I lead this people out, and You do not make known to me whom You are going to send with me, especially since You have said, 'I know you by name, and you have found favor before Me.'
verses.33:13: Therefore, if I have found favor in Your sight, show me Your face, so that I may know You and find favor before Your eyes; look upon Your people, this nation."
verses.33:14: And the Lord said, "My face will go ahead of you, and I will give you rest."
verses.33:15: And Moses said, "If You Yourself do not go ahead, do not lead us out of this place.
verses.33:16: For by what will I and Your people be able to know that we have found favor in Your sight, unless You walk with us, so that we may be glorified by all the peoples who dwell on the earth?"
verses.33:17: And the Lord said to Moses, "I will also do this word that you have spoken; for you have found favor before Me, and I know you yourself by name."
verses.33:19: He answered, "I Myself will show all good to you, and I will call out in the name of the Lord before you; and I will have mercy on whom I wish, and I will be compassionate toward whom it pleases Me."
verses.33:20: And again He said, "You will not be able to see My face; for a man will not see Me and live."
verses.33:21: And once more, "Look," He said, "there is a place beside Me, and you will stand upon the rock.
verses.33:22: And when My glory passes by, I will place you in a crevice of the rock, and I will shield you with My right hand until I pass by;
verses.33:23: and I will remove My hand, and you will see My back; but My face you will not be able to see."
verses.34:1: And afterward He said, "Cut out for yourself two stone tablets like the former ones, and I will write upon them the words that the tablets had which you broke.
verses.34:2: Be ready in the morning, so that you may go up immediately onto Mount Sinai, and you will stand with Me on the summit of the mountain.
verses.34:3: Let no one go up with you, nor let anyone be seen throughout the whole mountain; cattle and sheep also must not graze opposite it."
verses.34:4: So he cut out two stone tablets like those that had been before, and rising in the night, he went up onto Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded him, carrying the tablets with him.
verses.34:5: And when the Lord had come down through the cloud, Moses stood with Him, calling upon the name of the Lord.
verses.34:6: And as He passed by before him, he said, "Ruler, Lord God, merciful and gracious, patient and of great compassion, and truthful,
verses.34:7: who keep mercy to thousands; who take away iniquity, and crimes, and sins, and before You no one is innocent by himself; who repay the iniquity of fathers to sons and to grandsons, to the third and fourth generation."
verses.34:8: And hurrying, Moses bowed prostrate to the ground, and worshiping,
verses.34:9: said, "If I have found favor in Your sight, Lord, I beg that You walk with us (for it is a stiff-necked people) and take away our iniquities and sins, and possess us."
verses.34:10: The Lord answered, "I will enter into a covenant while all look on: I will perform signs that have never been seen upon the earth, nor among any nations, so that this people, in whose midst you are, may see the fearsome work of the Lord that I am about to do.
verses.34:11: Observe everything that I command you today: I Myself will drive out before your face the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, the Perizzite also, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.34:12: Be careful that you never form friendships with the inhabitants of that land, which would become a ruin to you;
verses.34:13: but destroy their altars, shatter the statues, and cut down the groves:
verses.34:14: do not worship a foreign god. The Lord: Jealous is His name; He is a jealous God.
verses.34:15: Do not enter into a covenant with the people of those regions, or else, when they have committed fornication with their gods and worshiped their images, someone may invite you to eat from what has been sacrificed.
verses.34:16: Nor shall you take a wife from their daughters for your sons, or else, after they themselves have committed fornication, they may cause your sons also to commit fornication after their gods.
verses.34:17: You shall not make molten gods for yourself.
verses.34:18: You shall keep the festival of unleavened bread. For seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I commanded you, at the time of the month of new crops; for in the month of the spring season you went out from Egypt.
verses.34:19: Everything of the male kind that opens the womb shall be Mine. From all animals, both of cattle and of sheep, it shall be Mine.
verses.34:20: The firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a sheep; but if you do not give a price for it, it shall be put to death. The firstborn of your sons you shall redeem; and you shall not appear in My sight empty-handed.
verses.34:21: For six days you shall work; on the seventh day you shall cease plowing and harvesting.
verses.34:22: You shall celebrate for yourself the festival of weeks with the firstfruits of the produce of your wheat harvest, and the festival when, as the season of the year returns, everything is stored away.
verses.34:23: At three times of the year every male of yours shall appear in the sight of the Almighty Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.34:24: For when I have removed the nations from before your face and enlarged your borders, no one shall lie in wait against your land while you go up and appear in the sight of the Lord your God three times a year.
verses.34:25: You shall not sacrifice the blood of My offering upon leaven, nor shall anything remain in the morning from the sacrifice of the Passover festival.
verses.34:26: The firstfruits of the produce of your land you shall offer in the house of the Lord your God. You shall not cook a young goat in its mother's milk."
verses.34:27: And the Lord said to Moses, "Write for yourself these words, by which I have made a covenant both with you and with Israel."
verses.34:28: So he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread, and he did not drink water; and he wrote on the tablets the ten words of the covenant.
verses.34:29: And as Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai, he was holding the two tablets of the testimony, and he did not know that his face was horned from the fellowship of the Lord's speech.
verses.34:30: Now Aaron and the sons of Israel, seeing the horned face of Moses, were afraid to come near.
verses.34:31: And called by him, both Aaron and the leaders of the assembly returned. And after he had spoken to them,
verses.34:32: all the sons of Israel also came to him, and he commanded them everything that he had heard from the Lord on Mount Sinai.
verses.34:33: And when his words were completed, he placed a veil over his face.
verses.34:34: When he went in to the Lord and spoke with Him, he would take it off until he went out, and then he would speak to the sons of Israel everything that had been commanded to him.
verses.34:35: And they would see that the face of Moses as he came out was horned, but he would cover his face again whenever he spoke to them.
verses.35:1: Therefore, when the whole crowd of the sons of Israel had been gathered together, he said to them, "These are the things that the Lord has commanded to be done.
verses.35:2: For six days you shall do work; the seventh day shall be holy to you, a Sabbath and a rest of the Lord: whoever does work on it shall be put to death.
verses.35:3: You shall not kindle a fire in any of your dwellings throughout the Sabbath day."
verses.35:4: And Moses said to the entire company of the sons of Israel, "This is the word that the Lord has commanded, saying:
verses.35:5: 'Set apart among yourselves firstfruits for the Lord. Let everyone who is willing and of a ready spirit offer them to the Lord: gold, and silver, and bronze,
verses.35:6: blue and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, and fine linen, goat hair,
verses.35:7: and ram skins dyed red, and violet-colored skins, acacia wood,
verses.35:8: and oil for preparing the lamps, and for compounding the ointment, and the most fragrant incense,
verses.35:9: onyx stones, and gems for the adornment of the shoulder-vestment and the breastpiece.
verses.35:10: Let everyone among you who is wise come and make what the Lord has commanded:
verses.35:11: namely, the tabernacle, and its roof and covering, the rings, and the boards with the bars, the pegs, and the bases;
verses.35:12: the ark and the poles, the mercy seat, and the veil that is stretched out in front of it;
verses.35:13: the table with the poles and utensils, and the loaves of presentation;
verses.35:14: the lampstand for supporting the lights, its utensils and lamps, and the oil for fueling the fires;
verses.35:15: the altar of incense and the poles, and the anointing oil and the incense of spices; the hanging at the doorway of the tabernacle;
verses.35:16: the altar of burnt offering, and its bronze grate with its poles and utensils; the basin and its base;
verses.35:17: the curtains of the courtyard with the pillars and bases, the hanging at the doors of the vestibule;
verses.35:18: the pegs of the tabernacle and of the courtyard with their cords;
verses.35:19: the garments whose use is in the ministry of the sanctuary, the vestments of Aaron the high priest and of his sons, so that they may serve in the priesthood for Me.'"
verses.35:20: And the entire multitude of the sons of Israel, having gone out from the presence of Moses,
verses.35:21: offered firstfruits to the Lord with a most ready and devoted mind for doing the work of the tabernacle of the testimony. Whatever was necessary for the worship and for the holy garments,
verses.35:22: men along with women provided: bracelets and earrings, rings and armlets; every gold vessel was set apart for the offerings of the Lord.
verses.35:23: If anyone had blue, and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, fine linen and goat hair, ram skins dyed red, and violet-colored skins,
verses.35:24: metals of silver and of bronze, they offered them to the Lord, and acacia wood for various uses.
verses.35:25: And skilled women also, who had spun, gave blue, purple, and crimson, and fine linen,
verses.35:26: and goat hair, giving everything of their own accord.
verses.35:27: Now the leaders offered onyx stones, and gems for the shoulder-vestment and the breastpiece,
verses.35:28: and spices and oil for tending the lights, and for preparing the ointment, and for compounding the incense of sweetest fragrance.
verses.35:29: All the men and women with a devoted mind presented offerings, so that the works might be made which the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses. All the sons of Israel dedicated voluntary offerings to the Lord.
verses.35:30: And Moses said to the sons of Israel, "Look, the Lord has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
verses.35:31: and has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom and understanding, and knowledge and all learning,
verses.35:32: to devise and to do work in gold, and silver, and bronze,
verses.35:33: and in carving stones, and in carpentry work; whatever can be skillfully devised,
verses.35:34: He has put in his heart; Oholiab also, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan:
verses.35:35: both of them He has instructed with wisdom, so that they may do the works of a woodworker, a tapestry-weaver, and an embroiderer, in blue and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, and fine linen, and weave all things, and invent all kinds of new things."
verses.36:1: Therefore Bezalel, Oholiab, and every wise man, to whom the Lord gave wisdom and understanding so that they might know how to work skillfully, made the things that are necessary for the uses of the sanctuary and that the Lord commanded.
verses.36:2: And when Moses had called them and every trained man to whom the Lord had given wisdom, and those who of their own accord had offered themselves to do the work,
verses.36:3: he handed over to them all the offerings of the sons of Israel. While they were pressing on with the work, every morning the people kept offering votive gifts.
verses.36:4: As a result, the craftsmen, compelled to come,
verses.36:5: said to Moses, "The people are offering more than is necessary."
verses.36:6: Therefore Moses commanded it to be proclaimed by the voice of a herald, "Let neither man nor woman offer anything further for the work of the sanctuary." And so the offering of gifts ceased,
verses.36:7: because the things offered were sufficient and more than abundant.
verses.36:8: And all who were wise in heart to complete the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of twisted fine linen, and violet-blue, and purple, and twice-dyed scarlet, with variegated work and embroidered craft,
verses.36:9: of which one had twenty-eight cubits in length and four in width; there was one measurement for all the curtains.
verses.36:10: And he joined five curtains, one to another, and the other five he linked together to one another.
verses.36:11: He also made violet-blue loops on the border of the one curtain on each side, and on the border of the other curtain likewise,
verses.36:12: so that the loops would come opposite one another and be joined together.
verses.36:13: Accordingly he also cast fifty golden rings to clasp the loops of the curtains, so that it would become one tabernacle.
verses.36:14: He also made eleven cloths of goats' hair to cover the roof of the tabernacle;
verses.36:15: one cloth had thirty cubits in length and four cubits in width; all the cloths were of one measurement;
verses.36:16: of these he joined five by themselves, and the other six separately.
verses.36:17: And he made fifty loops on the border of the one cloth, and fifty on the border of the other cloth, so that they might be joined to one another,
verses.36:18: and fifty bronze clasps by which the roof might be fastened, so that one covering would be made out of all the cloths.
verses.36:19: He also made a covering for the tabernacle of rams' skins dyed red, and another covering over it of violet-colored skins.
verses.36:20: He also made the upright boards of the tabernacle from acacia wood.
verses.36:21: Ten cubits was the length of one board, and the width measured one and a half cubits.
verses.36:22: There were two mortise joints on each board, so that one might be joined to another. Thus he did on all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.36:23: Of these, twenty were on the southern quarter toward the south,
verses.36:24: with forty silver bases. Two bases were placed under one board on both sides of the corners, where the mortise joints of the sides terminate at the corners.
verses.36:25: Also on the quarter of the tabernacle that faces toward the north, he made twenty boards,
verses.36:26: with forty silver bases, two bases for each board.
verses.36:27: Toward the west, however, that is, on that part of the tabernacle which faces the sea, he made six boards,
verses.36:28: and two others at each of the corners of the tabernacle at the back,
verses.36:29: which were joined from the bottom all the way to the top, and were brought together alike into one fastening. So he did on both sides at the corners,
verses.36:30: so that there were eight boards together, and they had sixteen silver bases, namely, two bases under each board.
verses.36:31: He also made bars of acacia wood: five to hold together the boards of one side of the tabernacle,
verses.36:32: and five others to fit together the boards of the other side; and besides these, five other bars for the western quarter of the tabernacle toward the sea.
verses.36:33: He also made another bar that passed through the middle of the boards from corner to corner.
verses.36:34: Now he gilded the boards themselves, with their bases cast of silver. And he made their rings of gold, through which the bars could be inserted, and these too he covered with plates of gold.
verses.36:35: He also made the veil of blue and purple, crimson and twisted fine linen, with patterned weaving, variegated and adorned:
verses.36:36: and four pillars of acacia wood, which he overlaid with gold along with their capitals, having cast their bases of silver.
verses.36:37: He also made a hanging at the entrance of the tabernacle of blue, purple, crimson, and twisted fine linen, with the work of an embroiderer,
verses.36:38: and five pillars with their capitals, which he overlaid with gold, and he cast their bases of bronze.
